content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery via crypto payment is a direct response to the limitations imposed by platforms like PayPal and Stripe. Creators can leverage tools like NOWPayments to enable seamless transactions, allowing them to sell their digital products without exorbitant fees. Unlike Gumroad, which takes a 10% cut from every sale, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This drastic difference in fees means more revenue retained by the creator, making this solution not just viable but essential for those locked out of mainstream payment systems.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of automated ebook delivery is a combination of free and paid tools that form a sovereign commerce stack. By utilizing platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, creators can set up their digital storefronts. Payment verification is handled by NOWPayments, which processes transactions in over 300 cryptocurrencies. This architecture ensures that transactions are secure, fast, and efficient, eliminating the need for any third-party control over the creator's earnings.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or heavily restrictive. If you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products, this stack empowers you to take control of your sales process. The architecture allows you to retain full ownership of your products and customer data, ensuring that your business isn't tied to the whims of platform changes or restrictions.
Retain more revenue with only a 0.5% transaction fee through NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The deployment of a sovereign commerce stack involves several key components. First, hosting is done through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, providing a reliable and free foundation. Next, backend logic is executed via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, allowing for automated order processing and delivery. Storage solutions like Supabase or Google Sheets are used for keeping track of orders, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 handles file deliveries. All these elements work in harmony to create a seamless experience for both the seller and the buyer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first set up your hosting using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, integrate Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend functionalities. Configure Supabase or Google Sheets to manage your orders and use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivering your ebooks. Finally, implement NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. For those looking for a comprehensive resource, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the blueprints and templates needed to build and scale your commerce stack effectively.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automated delivery ensures your customers receive their products instantly after payment.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell ebooks without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell ebooks by using a sovereign commerce stack that integrates NOWPayments for crypto payments. This setup allows you to accept payments without relying on traditional platforms, retaining full control over your sales.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The most effective way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is to implement a crypto payment solution like NOWPayments. This method significantly reduces transaction costs compared to platforms like Gumroad, allowing you to keep more of your sales revenue.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts through your own sovereign digital store powered by a combination of free tools and NOWPayments for crypto processing. This approach gives you full ownership and control over your sales.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?

With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin and Ethereum. This flexibility allows you to cater to a wider audience and adapt to various payment preferences.
How do I ensure automated delivery of my ebooks?
Automated delivery can be achieved using backend tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which handle order processing and file delivery seamlessly once a payment is confirmed.
Full control over your sales means you are not dependent on any platform.
